evals.name: audit-ui-against-vercel-source
evals.prompt:
I built a startup landing page using the Vercel DESIGN.md as my source style. Here's the code. Audit it against the source — tell me what drifted and what to fix. ```tsx // LandingPage.tsx export default function LandingPage() { return (

Build Faster With NeonEdge

The serverless database for modern teams.

Feature 1
Feature 2
Feature 3
); } ``` The Vercel DESIGN.md is at /home/mihai/code/skills/design-md-catalog/vercel/DESIGN.md

assertions.text: Output includes a findings list with priority labels (P1, P2, or P3)
Each finding includes a specific fix instruction, not just a description of the problem
Flags the serif font as inconsistent with Vercel's sans-serif typography DNA
Flags that the style is accent-only — the gradient hero is surface decoration without typography, spacing, or component geometry translation
Includes a Style Fit section with Fit level (strong/mixed/weak) and most important missing move
States the selected source slug or DESIGN.md file path
